author: ImRaging
body:
This appeal is for 'posting screamers in chat'. Please note that this is for Teamspeak 3, not an in-game appeal.

Yesterday (as of 29th May), me and another person were messing around on teamspeak. Him, two others and I were in the chat. He then asked for the Teamspeak soundboard and so I did post a  screamer. A little too late, I warned him not to click on it. I was then kicked for using screamers. Later, that night, someone in the chat said 'Raging I think you're getting banned'. I asked why and they didn't reply, so I just carried on playing good ol' Nebula. Then I was suddenly banned from ts, for 20 days. 

So the main reason why I made this appeal wasn't fully so I could get unbanned from ts, or even get a shortened time. It was because I wanted to say sorry to everyone I have caused inconvenience to, and to anyone I have hurt screamers or not. I know only staff will see this so I am mainly talking to you guys. Sorry. 

I have learnt from my mistakes and will refrain from posting screamers ever again.

-ImRaging.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Raging,

Your punishment was proper and valid and should be enforced.
However, in light of you being banned and not causing any issues for so long, and the upcoming tournament tomorrow, I have decided to accept your appeal.

However, expect utmost strictness on Teamspeak, and at any sign of misconduct, you will be punished with no appeal.
